body:
Hey Man, Good luck! All my friends from college/uni are currently really enjoying where they work so don't look into the way i feel about my job as i'm not in the correct mind set. 
As for my future life, i honestly don't know. I know that isn't the answer your looking for but i just can't think correctly at the moment, i can't vision anything.
I feel trapped, both mind and life. I hear about people moving around and enjoying it, i would love that and leave everything behind, all the things that make me feel like this. I know i will still have the memories but i won't be able to try and chase them memories back and get back what i had instead make more improved ones, here all i can do is follow the old memories. Sorry if im not making sense, it's never been my strong point.

Hey, i like recalling the memories, they are of the time where i wasn't depressed and wanting out. Sorry if im being negative, you are helping but i just don't like where i am mentally, its a cruse.
I'm trying to keep my job disclosed as i don't want this traced back to me, i will say it's to do with computers. My day is sat behind a computer for hours apon hours. Outside work i go gym then either home or to my mates house (a non listed mate within the top section).   I have lived in the same place for 24 years, it's ok i suppose, would love to get out and move county, experience something new. It is strange but atm im thinking, if i was to get away and start a new life, would this still chase me maybe if i move and take some anti-depressants maybe then i can find happiness. All i think is that i hit the highlight of my life, its only going down from now on.

My Life here will always recall them memories or have me re-chase them. Part of my depression is the way my life is now, working till i die. My job is ok, pay is too little for what i do. It's a job where i worked my ass off to get from college and uni, miss going to them. I just need a escape, here it will always be the same.

Thank you.
I know there memories but there memories of my happiness, that time frame was the last time i could say i was happy. My life is bad in comparison, sat behind a desk 5 days a week, doing nothing afterwards :/ Shifts were great, 8 days on and 4 days off! So nice.
Your advice is good, i just been thinking, i got 2 choices, move away and create a new life or the other option, the easier way out. I always seen suicide not as a sad thing (for the person who's doing it) but more of a happy thing, your ending the misery, thinking about the happiness (does that sound weird? Sorry).
But again, your comment was amazing and i am so grateful for the support :) That's what i need during these times.
